records.footnote: Data cover live and digital ticketed and non-ticketed performances only whilst data for year 2020 and 2021 include indivisible live, digital and hybrid ticketed and non-ticketed performances.  Due to circuit breaker measures, there is a general decline in in-person performing arts, entertainment and cultural activities and events as well as visual arts exhibitions in year 2020 and 2021.

row.rowText: Total Number Of Performing Arts And Entertainment Events
row.footnote: Performing arts events refer to performances of folk, traditional, classical and contemporary forms of dance, music (e.g. classical, traditional music etc) and theatre.  Entertainment events refer to large scale performances of contemporary music (e.g. pop/rock concerts).  Ticketed performances refer to performances which require a ticket for entry.  Data are provided by National Arts Council and People's Association.  National Arts Council compiled the data with returns from ticketing service providers.  It exclude ticketed performances sold through other site-specific or independent ticketing service providers.  Non-ticketed performances refer to performances for which no tickets are issued.  Data are provided by National Arts Council, People's Association and The Esplanade Company Ltd.  Digital performing arts and entertainment events are accessed through electronic media or the Internet.  This include formats such as live-streamed performances and streaming of pre-recorded videos performances etc.

row.rowText: Non-Ticketed Performing Arts And Entertainment Events

row.rowText: Total Number Of Visual Arts Exhibitions
row.footnote: Refers to public exhibitions of abstract or representational art objects such as painting, sculpture, pottery, ceramics, creative photography, installation art and multi-media art.  Applied arts such as film, graphic design, jewellery design and handicrafts are excluded.  Visual arts exhibitions may be held in-person or accessed digitally through electronic media or the Internet e.g. a virtual exhibition.  Data are based on published and online sources such as newspapers, websites and publications, as well as data from Singapore Art Gallery Guide, Art Galleries Association of Singapore, community art galleries, Gillman Barracks etc.  Data cover in-person and digital visual arts exhibitions and exhibition days only.  Data for year 2020 and 2021 include indivisible digital and hybrid exhibitions and exhibition days.

row.rowText: Total Number Of Visual Arts Exhibition Days
row.footnote: Refers to public exhibitions of abstract or representational art objects such as painting, sculpture, pottery, ceramics, creative photography, installation art and multi-media art.  Applied arts such as film, graphic design, jewellery design and handicrafts are excluded.  Visual arts exhibitions may be held in-person or accessed digitally through electronic media or the Internet e.g. a virtual exhibition.  Refers to the total number of days over which all exhibitions are held.  It exclude opening day/reception, exhibitions which are by appointment/for private viewing only, and permanent exhibitions of any museum.  Data are based on published and online sources such as newspapers, websites and publications, as well as data from Singapore Art Gallery Guide, Art Galleries Association of Singapore, community art galleries, Gillman Barracks etc.  Data cover in-person and digital visual arts exhibitions and exhibition days only.  Data for year 2020 and 2021 include indivisible digital and hybrid exhibitions and exhibition days.

row.rowText: Ticketed Attendance At Performing Arts And Entertainment Events
row.footnote: Performing arts events refer to performances of folk, traditional, classical and contemporary forms of dance, music (e.g. classical, traditional music etc) and theatre.  Entertainment events refer to large scale performances of contemporary music (e.g. pop/rock concerts).  Ticketed performing arts and entertainment events refer to performances which require a ticket for entry and may be held live or accessed digitally through electronic media or the Internet.  Events such as book launches, competitions, conferences, masterclasses, workshops etc are excluded.  Data are provided by National Arts Council and People's Association.  National Arts Council compile the data with returns from ticketing service providers.  It exclude ticketed performances sold through other site-specific or independent ticketing service providers.  Year 2020 and 2021 data include indivisible in-person and digital data from the People's Association.  Hybrid non-ticketed arts events in year 2022 are excluded.
